title.zh: 将高山省Paracelis市镇国立中学正式更名为Serapio Gawan纪念中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Paracelis National High School in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Paracelis, Mountain Province to Serapio Gawan
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Paracelis National High School in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Paracelis, Mountain Province to Serapio Gawan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11627_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Paracelis National High School in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Paracelis, Mountain Province is hereby changed to Serapio Gawan National High School.
The main campus of the Serapio Gawan National High School shall continue to remain in its present location in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Paracelis, Mountain Province.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
